# Mappingg

> Mappingg (mappingg.com) is a live, interactive map of real estate projects in Pune and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, built and maintained by Associatte Proptech Pvt Ltd, Pune. Every project is pinned at its actual location and colour-coded by status: available, under construction, upcoming or sold.

## Key facts

- Coverage in Pune: Mundhwa, Kharadi, Magarpatta, Hadapsar, Viman Nagar, Wagholi, Kothrud
- Coverage in the Mumbai region: Andheri West, Khar West, Vashi, Nerul, Kharghar, Airoli, Juinagar, Thane, Dombivli, Kalyan Shil Road, Palava
- As of September 2026: 184 projects mapped (127 under construction, 27 available, 21 upcoming, 9 sold)
- Project details, where available: developer, location, configuration, carpet area, price, possession timeline, key highlights, brochure, video
- Infrastructure shown on the map: metro stations and lines, bridges, flyovers, proposed roads, schools, hospitals, gardens
- Browsing costs nothing. Full project details unlock after a visitor shares their name, WhatsApp number and email for that project.
- Audience: home buyers and investors, sales agents and channel partners, developers
